patterns.name: UUID instead of branded ID
patterns.description: Entity creation uses crypto.randomUUID() instead of generating branded IDs matching the type system (F###, P###, S###)
patterns.root_cause: Repositories use generic UUID generation without awareness of branded type conventions
patterns.prevention: Implement sequential ID generation in base repository or ID service
patterns.detection: Check create handlers for crypto.randomUUID() vs branded format
patterns.fix_pattern: Query max(id), parse numeric suffix, increment, format with prefix

patterns.name: State machine duplication
patterns.description: VALID_TRANSITIONS constant duplicated across server and client code
patterns.root_cause: No shared package exports state machine logic, each module defines its own
patterns.prevention: Define state machines in @nomos-ai/types and import everywhere
patterns.fix_pattern: Extract to shared package, export as const, import in consumers

patterns.name: DB schema / Zod schema drift
patterns.description: Drizzle table schema missing columns that exist in the corresponding Zod type schema
patterns.root_cause: Zod schemas and Drizzle schemas evolved independently without cross-validation
patterns.prevention: Add build-time check comparing Zod schema keys against Drizzle column names
patterns.detection: Compare exported Zod schema shape with Drizzle table columns
patterns.fix_pattern: Add missing columns + migration, or remove from Zod schema if not needed

patterns.name: TOCTOU in bulk operations
patterns.description: Bulk status update validates then modifies in separate steps without transaction
patterns.root_cause: Validation and mutation not wrapped in same transaction
patterns.prevention: Always use transactions for validate-then-mutate patterns
patterns.detection: Look for await Promise.all() followed by separate update calls

patterns.name: Error handling boilerplate duplication
patterns.description: Identical try-catch error handling pattern repeated across all oRPC router handlers
patterns.root_cause: No shared error handling middleware or utility
patterns.prevention: Create withErrorHandling wrapper or oRPC middleware
patterns.fix_pattern: Extract to shared utility function in packages/api/src/utils/
